payload.reason: The evidence describes a simplification of the architecture in the SEPT model that maintains performance while reducing complexity.

claims.text: The architecture was simplified by removing the pruner and using a simple pooling layer for span extraction instead of more complex attention mechanisms or LSTM networks.
Despite the simplifications, the SEPT model achieves the same performance as previous models, demonstrating that the simplified architecture is effective.
The model combines the span extractor with BERT, which contributes to its performance while simplifying the overall architecture.
